section_title: Other AFC regulations that impact organizations > Other sanctions regimes

propositions.proposition: 组织需根据自身地理足迹以及因客户、供应商等第三方活动带来的管辖暴露，确定并遵守其他制裁制度。
source_quotes: Along with the major sanctions regimes, organizations might need to comply with other sanctions regimes. This depends on their own geographical footprint as well as jurisdictional exposure stemming from the activities of their customers, suppliers, and other third parties.

trigger_or_context: 客户、供应商等第三方活动带来的管辖暴露
candidate_frame.focal_handling_or_judgment: 组织需要遵守其他制裁制度
